items.title: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers
items.summary: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in the country said on Wednesday.

items.title: Readout of November 2026 U.S.-China Crisis Communications and Prevention Working Group
items.summary: The U.S. and China agreed on the importance of advancing practical communication measures to reduce the risks between the two countries during a Crisis Communications and Prevention Working Group meeting.

items.title: Married off at 14: In Yemen’s war, women and girls suffer ‘devastating consequences’
items.summary: Safa is 14. Her mother died earlier this year. She has no brothers or sisters. And a few weeks ago, as the crisis took hold, her father married her to an elderly man, afraid that if he were killed in the hostilities, no one would be left to protect her.

items.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many
items.summary: More than 280,000 people have now been displaced by fighting in Yemen and many vulnerable people are unable to access lifesaving relief because it is too dangerous to do so, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Friday.
